_comment: Explicit, file-backed mapping from the 4 homeostatic variables (energy, social_need, curiosity, stress) plus recent_novelty (a fast-decaying real-event signal, deliberately separate from curiosity -- see homeostatic_state.py's dataclass comment for why) to the Face Engine's real 5D AppraisalVector (valence, arousal, control, novelty, obstruct). Coefficients are a real, reasoned design, revised 2026-08-04 after a real test found the first version routing prolonged-silence/boredom to 'face_shocked_pale' instead of a sad/lonely expression -- the bug was novelty being driven by curiosity (the drive to WANT novelty) instead of recent_novelty (whether something ACTUALLY novel just happened), which are near-opposite during silence. NOT calibrated against real BMO-Project deployment data (none exists yet). Ranges (clamp) taken directly from observed min/max in the real face_tags.csv (32 rows, /home/bmo/bmo_fresh/BMO Face Engine/face_tags.csv, read 2026-08-04): valence in [-1,1], arousal/control/novelty/obstruct in [0,1].
